title: Budget & savings coach
summary: A friendly budgeting app with savings jars, plain-language coaching and a simple mode.
ideas: Add a 'safe to spend today' number that updates as the user logs spending
Let users set a savings goal with a date and show if they are on track
Add WhatsApp-style quick actions: 'Log £5 coffee' in one tap
Translate the whole app into Spanish, Polish and Bengali with a language picker
guide: Pages: src/pages/Overview.jsx (balance, spending donut, weekly trend), src/pages/Jars.jsx (savings goals with progress and a growth projection), src/pages/Coach.jsx (rule-based tips from src/coach.js). src/i18n.js holds the EN/ES/PL dictionary used via the t() helper passed down from App.jsx; the 'Simple mode' switch in App.jsx makes text larger for accessibility. All data is fake and lives in src/data.js.
